title: My Old Kentucky Home
composition: words and music by Stephen Foster (1853); public domain
credit: Recording by Grantyny, released under CC BY 3.0 on Wikimedia Commons, so the credit is part of the licence. Foster's original chorus is omitted: it uses a term this catalogue will not print.
lyrics: The sun shines bright in the old Kentucky home
Tis summer, the people are gay
The corn top's ripe and the meadow's in the bloom
While the birds make music all the day
The young folks roll on the little cabin floor
All merry, all happy and bright
By and by hard times comes a-knocking at the door
Then my old Kentucky home, good night
